Goblin Civilian

CR 1/3

XP 135
Goblin commoner 1
NE Small humanoid (goblinoid)

DEFENSE

AC 13, touch 13, flat-footed 10 (+2 Dex, +1 size)
hp 4 (1d6+1)
Fort +1, Ref +2, Will -1

OFFENSE

Speed 30 ft.
Melee unarmed strike +1 (1d2)

During Combat the goblin civilians flee at the PC’s approach, although they will make a stand to protect their kin

STATISTICS

Str 11, Dex 15, Con 12, Int 10, Wis 9, Cha 6
Base Atk +0; CMB -1; CMD 11
Feats Improved Initiative
Skills Ride +10, Stealth +10, Swim +4; Racial Modifiers +4 Ride, +4 Stealth
Languages Goblin
NPC Gear rags
